findings.summary: R1 milestone mapping includes M1 (Intake) but R1 is a system-level ingestion requirement that cannot be delivered until M3 (Generate: Thin-slice plugin set #1 — ingestion + Markdown render + minimal templates + emit) when the Ingestion Plugin (C11) is implemented.

evidence.quote: The system MUST accept a user-specified local directory path as input and recursively discover Markdown files

evidence.note: M1 is Intake milestone focused on confirming conventions and blockers, not implementation.
evidence.quote: Intake: Confirm conventions, scale, IA, and CLI workflow (blockers) + security trust model

evidence.note: M3 delivers Ingestion Plugin (C11) which implements R1.
evidence.quote: Ingestion Plugin (C11): recursive discovery of .md files, populating note records (R1).

findings.summary: R2 milestone mapping includes M1 (Intake) but R2 is a system-level output requirement that cannot be delivered until M3 (Generate: Thin-slice plugin set #1) when the Emit Plugin (C17) is implemented to write static output assets.

evidence.quote: The system MUST generate a static build output consisting only of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other static assets

evidence.note: M1 is Intake milestone with no implementation deliverables.
evidence.quote: Intake: Confirm conventions, scale, IA, and CLI workflow (blockers) + security trust model

evidence.note: M3 delivers Emit Plugin (C17) which implements R2.
evidence.quote: Emit Plugin (C17): write static output assets only (R2) and support CLI-driven output directory generation (R5).

findings.summary: R3 milestone mapping includes M1 (Intake) but R3 is a system-level parsing/rendering requirement that cannot be delivered until M3 (Generate: Thin-slice plugin set #1) when the Markdown Render Plugin (C14) is implemented.

evidence.quote: The system MUST parse each discovered Markdown file using at least CommonMark-compliant syntax and generate a corresponding HTML page

evidence.note: M1 is Intake milestone with no implementation deliverables.
evidence.quote: Intake: Confirm conventions, scale, IA, and CLI workflow (blockers) + security trust model

evidence.note: M3 delivers Markdown Render Plugin (C14) which implements R3.
evidence.quote: Markdown Render Plugin (C14): CommonMark-compliant parsing/rendering with preserved structure (R3/R4).
